source.source_binding_markers: low-area binary-luminance barcode outside the central semantic-anchor region; first 64 frames only
source.independent_anchor_references: separately rendered 40x40 grayscale geometry, not crops from source or decoded video

anchor_visibility.quality_scored_rule: at least one independently rendered expected answer anchor must pass visibility in each of default, uniform, and temporal selected-frame sets
anchor_visibility.selection_control_rule: default and uniform must contain no declared late answer-anchor source frame; temporal must contain at least one visible declared answer anchor

cases.question: Which shape moves first in the video? Answer with one shape name.
第一次画面切换后，中央出现什么图案？只回答图案名称。
長い静止区間で中央に保たれている記号は何ですか？記号名だけで答えてください。
¿Qué símbolo aparece dentro del marco central al principio del video? Responde solo con el nombre del símbolo.
Which shape moves after the long middle static interval? Answer with one shape name.
第三次画面切换后，中央出现什么图案？只回答图案名称。
後半の短い変化で中央に現れる記号は何ですか？記号名だけで答えてください。
¿Qué símbolo aparece en el último cuadro? Responde solo con el nombre del símbolo.

scoring.expect_all_semantics: every preregistered term must occur in the casefolded raw answer
scoring.expect_any_group_semantics: at least one preregistered canonical-language term must occur in the casefolded raw answer
limitations: substring matching can over- or under-count linguistic variants
four quality-scored synthetic cases are fixture evidence only
selection-miss controls are diagnostics and are never relabelled as perceptual failures or successes

measurement.prefix_cache: disabled; prefix_reused=0 for every request including warmup
measurement.native_evidence: exact selected RGB fingerprints, source frame indices, source PTS and presentation order, temporal-2 pair-first timestamps, mRoPE digest, serial/batch parity, complete binary/model/source provenance
